abort.already_configured: The add-on's Voice PE is set up already: the add-on serves one device.

user.title: The add-on's Voice PE
user.description: Pick the Voice PE that runs the add-on's firmware. It becomes an Assist satellite, so Home Assistant's announce and start conversation actions reach the OpenAI assistant on it.

discovery_confirm.title: The add-on's Voice PE
discovery_confirm.description: Set up {name}, the Voice PE that runs the add-on's firmware, as an Assist satellite? Home Assistant's announce and start conversation actions will then reach the OpenAI assistant on it.

init.title: The add-on's address
init.description: Where the Voice PE finds the add-on. Leave empty for Home Assistant's own address on your network, which suits the add-on running on Home Assistant's host; set it if the device needs another, such as a name it resolves. It starts with wss:// and ends with the add-on's port.

error.not_wss: The address must start with wss://: the add-on only takes encrypted connections.
